pli-tv-bu-vb-np1:0.6: Ime kho panāyasmanto tiṃsa nissaggiyā pācittiyā dhammā uddesaṃ āgacchanti.
pli-tv-bu-vb-np1:1.1: Tena samayena buddho bhagavā Vesāliyaṃ viharati Gotamake cetiye.
pli-tv-bu-vb-np1:1.2: tena kho pana samayena bhagavatā bhikkhūnaṃ ticīvaraṃ anuññātaṃ hoti.
pli-tv-bu-vb-np1:1.3: chabbaggiyā bhikkhū bhagavatā ticīvaraṃ anuññātan ti aññen' eva ticīvarena gāmaṃ pavisanti aññena ticīvarena ārāme acchanti aññena ticīvarena nahānaṃ otaranti.
pli-tv-bu-vb-np1:1.4: ye te bhikkhū appicchā te ujjhāyanti khīyanti vipācenti:
pli-tv-bu-vb-np1:1.5: kathaṃ hi nāma chabbaggiyā bhikkhū atirekacīvaraṃ dhāressantīti.
pli-tv-bu-vb-np1:1.6: atha kho te bhikkhū bhagavato etam atthaṃ ārocesuṃ.
pli-tv-bu-vb-np1:1.7: saccaṃ kira tumhe bhikkhave atirekacīvaraṃ dhārethā 'ti.
pli-tv-bu-vb-np1:1.10: hi nāma tumhe moghapurisā atirekacīvaraṃ dhāressatha.
pli-tv-bu-vb-np1:1.11: n' etaṃ moghapurisā appasannānaṃ vā pasādāya --pa--,
pli-tv-bu-vb-np1:1.12: evañ ca pana bhikkhave imaṃ sikkhāpadaṃ uddiseyyātha:
pli-tv-bu-vb-np1:1.13.1: yo pana bhikkhu atirekacīvaraṃ dhāreyya, nissaggiyaṃ pācittiyan ti.
pli-tv-bu-vb-np1:1.14: evañ c' idaṃ bhagavatā bhikkhūnaṃ sikkhāpadaṃ paññattaṃ hoti. ||1||
pli-tv-bu-vb-np1:2.1.1: tena kho pana samayena āyasmato Ānandassa atirekacīvaraṃ uppannaṃ hoti
pli-tv-bu-vb-np1:2.2: āyasmā ca Ānando taṃ cīvaraṃ āyasmato Sāriputtassa dātukāmo hoti
pli-tv-bu-vb-np1:2.4: atha kho āyasmato Ānandassa etad ahosi:
pli-tv-bu-vb-np1:2.8: ahañ c' imaṃ cīvaraṃ āyasmato Sāriputtassa dātukāmo
pli-tv-bu-vb-np1:2.10: kathaṃ nu kho mayā paṭipajjitabban ti.
pli-tv-bu-vb-np1:2.11: atha kho āyasmā Ānando bhagavato etam atthaṃ ārocesi.
pli-tv-bu-vb-np1:2.13: navamaṃ vā bhagavā divasaṃ dasamaṃ vā 'ti.
pli-tv-bu-vb-np1:2.14: atha kho bhagavā etasmiṃ nidāne etasmiṃ pakaraṇe dhammiṃ kathaṃ katvā bhikkhū āmantesi:
pli-tv-bu-vb-np1:2.16: evañ ca pana bhikkhave imaṃ sikkhāpadaṃ uddiseyyātha:
pli-tv-bu-vb-np1:2.17.1: niṭṭhitacīvarasmiṃ bhikkhunā ubbhatasmiṃ kaṭhine dasāhaparamaṃ atirekacīvaraṃ dhāretabbaṃ, taṃ atikkāmayato nissaggiyaṃ pācittiyan ti. ||2||
pli-tv-bu-vb-np1:3.1.2: bhikkhuno cīvaraṃ kataṃ vā hoti naṭṭhaṃ vā vinaṭṭhaṃ vā daḍḍhaṃ vā cīvarāsā vā upacchinnā.
pli-tv-bu-vb-np1:3.1.4: aṭṭhannaṃ mātikānaṃ aññatarāya mātikāya ubbhataṃ hoti saṃghena vā antarā ubbhataṃ hoti.
pli-tv-bu-vb-np1:3.2.3: nissajjitabbaṃ saṃghassa vā gaṇassa vā puggalassa vā.
pli-tv-bu-vb-np1:3.2.5: tena bhikkhunā saṃghaṃ upasaṃkamitvā ekaṃsaṃ uttarāsaṅgaṃ karitvā vuḍḍhānaṃ bhikkhūnaṃ pāde vanditvā ukkuṭikaṃ nisīditvā añjaliṃ paggahetvā evam assa vacanīyo:
pli-tv-bu-vb-np1:3.2.6: idaṃ me bhante cīvaraṃ dasāhātikkantaṃ nissaggiyaṃ,
pli-tv-bu-vb-np1:3.2.12: idaṃ cīvaraṃ itthannāmassa bhikkhuno nissaggiyaṃ saṃghassa nissaṭṭhaṃ.
pli-tv-bu-vb-np1:3.2.13: yadi saṃghassa pattakallaṃ, saṃgho imaṃ cīvaraṃ itthannāmassa bhikkhuno dadeyyā 'ti.
pli-tv-bu-vb-np1:3.2.14: tena bhikkhunā sambahule bhikkhū upasaṃkamitvā ekaṃsaṃ uttarāsaṅgaṃ karitvā vuḍḍhānaṃ . . . paggahetvā evam assu vacanīyā:
pli-tv-bu-vb-np1:3.2.15: idaṃ me bhante cīvaraṃ dasāhātikkantaṃ nissaggiyaṃ,
pli-tv-bu-vb-np1:3.2.21: idaṃ cīvaraṃ itthannāmassa bhikkhuno nissaggiyaṃ āyasmantānaṃ nissaṭṭhaṃ.
pli-tv-bu-vb-np1:3.2.22: yad' āyasmantānaṃ pattakallaṃ, āyasmantā imaṃ cīvaraṃ itthannāmassa bhikkhuno dadeyyun ti.
pli-tv-bu-vb-np1:3.2.23: tena bhikkhunā ekaṃ bhikkhuṃ upasaṃkamitvā ekaṃsaṃ uttarāsaṅgaṃ karitvā ukkuṭikaṃ nisīditvā añjaliṃ paggahetvā evam assa vacanīyo:
pli-tv-bu-vb-np1:3.2.24: idaṃ me āvuso cīvaraṃ dasāhātikkantaṃ nissaggiyaṃ,
pli-tv-bu-vb-np1:4.11: nissaggiyaṃ cīvaraṃ anissajjitvā paribhuñjati, āpatti dukkaṭassa.
pli-tv-bu-vb-np1:4.16: anto dasāhaṃ adhiṭṭheti vikappeti vissajjeti nassati vinassati ḍayhati acchinditvā gaṇhanti vissāsaṃ gaṇhanti,
pli-tv-bu-vb-np1:5.1: tena kho pana samayena chabbaggiyā bhikkhū nissaṭṭhacīvaraṃ na denti.
